response: A full-year member was a NIFTY 50 constituent for the entire calendar year. A partial-year member entered or left the index during the year, so its reported membership-period performance covers only the applicable dates.

instruction: Does appearing in the yearly NIFTY 50 list mean there were more than 50 constituents at the same time?
context: {"important_distinction": "A calendar year can contain more than 50 distinct companies because constituents change during the year."}
response: No. The NIFTY 50 maintains 50 constituents at a given reconstitution period. More than 50 distinct companies can appear in a calendar year because some companies leave and others enter during that year.
